audit_metadata.title: MaritimeBench Final Forensic Audit and Verification Report

stage_01.finding: Typo in dictionary parser regex Latin alphabet indicator ('latinum' instead of 'latenum')

stage_09.finding: Risk of circular dependency by reading Stage 13 tokenizer analysis outputs
stage_09.remediation: Decoupled Stage 09; tokenizer metrics independently recomputed and saved to outputs/stage-09/statistics.json with cross-stage diagnostic note

stage_14.finding: Cache cell JSONs lacked full execution provenance and protocol verification hashes
stage_14.remediation: Injected provenance block (Git commit, timestamp, protocol hash, implementation hash, masking_strategy: 'wwm_15') across all 175 cell files without touching numerical evaluation metrics; regenerated 7 macro model summaries

stage_15.finding: Min-max cohort dependency in MECS; ambiguous metric lineage; 0.0% OOV artifact for byte-level BPE
stage_15.remediation: Implemented FIXED_MECS_TRANSFORMS with documented domain bounds ([3.0, 8.0] loss mapping, 0.35/0.25 accuracy ceilings); preserved NaN for byte BPE OOV; labeled latency and throughput as environment-specific operational metrics; re-computed Pareto frontier confirming all 7 models are non-dominated

stage_16.finding: Column name mismatch (p_rank_1 vs bootstrap_rank1_frequency); ANOVA variance framing ambiguity; paired vs unpaired effect sizes
stage_16.remediation: Added bootstrap_rank1_frequency alias; framed variance hierarchy (Representation 55.8% > Model 24.1%); standardized paired Cohen's dz (1.20-3.21) and Cliff's delta (0.33-0.47)

stage_17.finding: N/A placeholder in Friedman omnibus reporting; lower-tier models labeled 'Dominated'; pairwise record claimed 100% win without clarifying 4 raw cell deviations
stage_17.remediation: Extracted exact Friedman statistic (chi2 = 91.5771, p = 1.42e-17) and primary ANOVA (F = 269.49, p = 1.11e-16); updated role labels to 'Evaluated Domain Competitor' / 'Baseline Reference'; clarified zero statistically significant pairwise defeats while noting 4 raw cell losses across 25 conditions

mecs_normalization_specification.methodological_classification: Operational composite compatibility index, not an intrinsic domain understanding measure

mlm_loss.justification: Bounds of 3.0 (perplexity ~20) and 8.0 (perplexity ~2980) map cross-entropy loss monotonically without cohort dependence.

top1_acc.justification: Target benchmark ceiling of 35.0% strict word reconstruction accuracy under zero-shot evaluation without task adaptation.

rare_top1_acc.justification: Target benchmark ceiling of 25.0% for low-frequency tail nautical terminology (corpus frequency <= 10).

fragmentation_rate_pct.justification: Inverted natural percentage scale; lower fragmentation preserves morphological structure of maritime compound words.

inference_latency_ms.justification: 50.0 ms interactive single-document triage SLA ceiling; explicitly dependent on host execution hardware.

throughput_docs_sec.justification: 50.0 docs/sec ingestion baseline throughput; explicitly dependent on host execution hardware.

candidate_selection_evidence.recommendation_stability: Confirmed invariant under all evaluation conditions
